mission.title: Genev
mission.description: Find out what has become of Genev, one of Anome's lieutenants.

npc.say: Damn you, what's your business with Genev? If you've hurt her...
We're Curiosity, and you're the Cat.

phase.briefing: {player}, operatives in the field recently uncovered what may be an important clue: the name "Genev," probably one of Anome's current lieutenants. A search of our data records indicates that "Genev" was the name of a female Zion operative. You will question Zion operative Zion Selective Phage, known as a past associate of Genev, regarding Genev's current status.

enter.say: Zion Selective Phage's supposed to be in there.

talk.say:
Hey! You can't just barge in here! Who do you think you are?
The Machines? Huh! We may have a Truce, but that doesn't mean I have to give you classified information. What do you want?
Genev? No, I haven't seen her for weeks. Why? Have you seen her? Do you know where she is? What do you want with her?

done.say: That wasn't very informative, except that her disappearance corresponds roughly with Anome's break with Zion.

phase.briefing: The Zionite's reluctance to share information is of no consequence, {player}. While you distracted them, we accessed their terminal and located Genev's mail address. A computer at the indicated location will give you access to her messages. You will read them and locate information pertinent to her current status.

enter.say: Oh boy, nothing like reading through someone else's old mail. I bet we find some good dirt on this girl.

objective.text: Search the computer for information on Genev

done.say: Whoa. I think I'm going to start answering my email like that.

phase.briefing:
Of the information you retrieved, the reply to Bohrmann is of interest. Genev indicated that she would give Bohrmann a demonstration of her "power"; this indicates that Bohrmann may have seen her recently, or may see her soon.
You are being routed to Bohrmann's known base of operation in the Matrix. Search the area for further information on Bohrmann or Genev.

enter.say: That's Bohrmann's hangout. Nothing on my screen.

done.say: Either this was a setup, or something already happened between Genev and Bohrmann...

phase.briefing:
We find it...unlikely that Anome would have constructed this as an elaborate ruse to trap you, {player}.
On the other hand, it is probable that Genev has made contact with Bohrmann already. Perhaps a more straightforward approach is called for. We have taken the liberty of sending Bohrmann an email on your behalf, asking about Genev. Proceed to the indicated computer and await their reply.

enter.say: I hope you have a spam blocker set up. I don't think I can take reading another message about a new way to impress my girlfriend.

objective.text: Search the computer for a message from Bohrmann

mission.finish:
This is useful intelligence, {player}. There may yet be a chance to intercept either Genev or her contact in Lemone at some point. Surveillance must be established.
If Genev has been modified by a cheat code vial, she presents a significant threat to the Matrix, and must be terminated.
